title: Vehicle Inspection Validity Standard for Wayfare Driver Agreements
content:
This validity standard of the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product defines how long a recorded vehicle inspection counts as the inspection on file.

## Article 1. Terms

**Inspection validity days:** the calendar days, counted from the inspection date, for which a passed vehicle inspection uploaded to the standing record counts as the vehicle inspection on file.

**The inspection:** the latest vehicle inspection upload on the standing record. **Inspection date:** the date of that upload entry.

## Article 2. Effect of recording

An inspection upload carries no expiry date of its own: support records it, and the vehicle inspection expiry date on the agreement becomes the inspection date plus the inspection validity days.

## Article 3. Length

The inspection validity days are the inspection interval of the agreement's level, in months as the level schedule of required documents gives it, counted at 30 days to the month: the interval in months multiplied by 30. No rounding applies beyond whole days.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inspections, inspection date 2026-03-02)

| Level | Inspection interval from the schedule | Inspection validity days | Vehicle inspection expiry date on the agreement |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Black | 6 months | 180 | 2026-08-29 |
| Wayfare Standard | 12 months | 360 | 2027-02-25 |

A month counts as 30 days whatever its calendar length, so a 12-month interval gives 360 days.
